entry.name: jit.gl.nurbs
entry.description: Renders a Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS) surface. A NURBS is a mathematical model that lets you represent virtually any desired shape, from points, straight lines, and polylines to conic sections (circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas) to free-form curves with arbitrary shapes.
